<meta-data
              android:name="com.google.android.gms.ads.APPLICATION_ID"
              android:value="ca-app-pub-8094152890068517~9900106551            import 'dart:io';
            import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';
            
            class AdService {
              static final AdService _instance = AdService._internal();
              factory AdService() => _instance;
              AdService._internal();
            
              // TEST ID'leri — canlıya geçince gerçek ID ile değiştir
              static String get _clientAddUnitId => Platform.isIOS
                  ? 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1712485313'   // iOS test rewarded
                  : 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/5224354917';  // Android test rewarded
            
              static String get _periodAddUnitId => Platform.isIOS
                  ? 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1712485313'
                  : 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/5224354917';
            
              RewardedAd? _clientAd;
              RewardedAd? _periodAd;
            
              Future init() => MobileAds.instance.initialize();
            
              Future loadClientAd() async {
                await RewardedAd.load(
                  adUnitId: _clientAddUnitId,
                  request: const AdRequest(),
                  rewardedAdLoadCallback: RewardedAdLoadCallback(
                    onAdLoaded: (ad) => _clientAd = ad,
                    onAdFailedToLoad: (_) => _clientAd = null,
                  ),
                );
              }
            
              Future loadPeriodAd() async {
                await RewardedAd.load(
                  adUnitId: _periodAddUnitId,
                  request: const AdRequest(),
                  rewardedAdLoadCallback: RewardedAdLoadCallback(
                    onAdLoaded: (ad) => _periodAd = ad,
                    onAdFailedToLoad: (_) => _periodAd = null,
                  ),
                );
              }
            
              /// [onRewarded] → reklam izlendi, devam et
              /// [onFailed]   → reklam yok/hata, ne yapılacağı caller'a bırakılıyor
              Future showClientAd({
                required void Function() onRewarded,
                required void Function() onFailed,
              }) async {
                if (_clientAd == null) { onFailed(); return; }
                _clientAd!.fullScreenContentCallback = FullScreenContentCallback(
                  onAdDismissedFullScreenContent: (ad) { ad.dispose(); _clientAd = null; loadClientAd(); },
                  onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent: (ad, _) { ad.dispose(); _clientAd = null; loadClientAd(); onFailed(); },
                );
                await _clientAd!.show(onUserEarnedReward: (_, __) => onRewarded());
              }
            
              Future showPeriodAd({
                required void Function() onRewarded,
                required void Function() onFailed,
              }) async {
                if (_periodAd == null) { onFailed(); return; }
                _periodAd!.fullScreenContentCallback = FullScreenContentCallback(
                  onAdDismissedFullScreenContent: (ad) { ad.dispose(); _periodAd = null; loadPeriodAd(); },
                  onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent: (ad, _) { ad.dispose(); _periodAd = null; loadPeriodAd(); onFailed(); },
                );
                await _periodAd!.show(onUserEarnedReward: (_, __) => onRewarded());
              }
            }"
              />
